```{=html}
<!--
  PIPELINE REPLAY. Included by slides.qmd via {{< include >}}.

  This is a REPLAY, not live inference. Every stage duration is the real measured
  p50 from `pipeline_latency_development` in the benchmark bundle, so the clock
  is honest and the shape of the bar is the finding. The OUTPUTS are canned and
  synthetic -- no model runs, nothing is fetched, and the petition is written for
  this slide. The label on the component says so and it must stay.

  TWO PATHS, one component. Switching to "Typed complaint" drops OCR and the
  summary and the whole run finishes in 0.13s against 13.66s -- about 100x, and
  the entire difference is those two stages. That contrast is the argument for
  the toggle existing: it is far stronger shown than stated.

  ODIA. Chromium renders Odia natively on macOS, verified, so the script is used
  directly with no embedded font. The romanization sits underneath anyway, so
  the meaning survives on a machine whose font stack lacks Odia and the audience
  gets both readings regardless.

  No build step, no library, no network. It has to survive a room with no wifi.
-->
<div class="replay fb-host" id="replay">
  <div class="fb"><img src="assets/fallback/replay.png" alt="The pipeline replay, run to completion: reading the page and drafting the summary are 92% of 13.66 seconds"></div>

  <div class="replay-bar">
    <div class="replay-seg2" id="replay-path">
      <button data-path="doc" class="active">Scanned petition</button>
      <button data-path="txt">Typed complaint</button>
    </div>
    <div class="replay-controls">
      <button id="replay-go" class="replay-btn">Run</button>
      <button id="replay-speed" class="replay-btn replay-btn-quiet" data-mult="1">1&times;</button>
      <span class="replay-clock" id="replay-clock">0.0s</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="replay-stage">
    <div class="replay-in" id="replay-in">
      <div class="replay-in-h" id="replay-in-h">Scan &middot; 2 pages</div>
      <div class="replay-in-body">
        <p class="replay-od">ଝରପଡ଼ା ରେ ପାଣି ଯୋଗାଣ ନିୟମିତ ନାହିଁ</p>
        <p class="replay-rom">Jharpada re pani jogana niyamita nahin</p>
        <p class="replay-gloss">&ldquo;Water supply in Jharpada is not regular&rdquo;</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="replay-feed" id="replay-feed">&rarr;</div>
    <div class="replay-track" id="replay-track"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="replay-out">
    <div class="replay-card" data-out="redact">
      <span class="replay-card-h">Redacted text</span>
      <span class="replay-card-b">&ldquo;… water supply to <em>[NAME]</em>&rsquo;s ward
      irregular three weeks. Contact <em>[PHONE]</em> …&rdquo;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="replay-card" data-out="categorize">
      <span class="replay-card-h">Category shortlist</span>
      <span class="replay-card-b"><b>Infrastructure</b> · Social Welfare · General</span>
    </div>
    <div class="replay-card" data-out="route">
      <span class="replay-card-h">Route shortlist</span>
      <span class="replay-card-b"><b>Collector → BDO</b> · Collector → EE, RWSS</span>
    </div>
    <div class="replay-card" data-out="summarize">
      <span class="replay-card-h">Draft summary</span>
      <span class="replay-card-b">Irregular piped water supply affecting one ward
      for three weeks. Requests restoration.</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="replay-note" id="replay-note"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // Measured p50 seconds from pipeline_latency_development. `heavy` marks the
  // two stages worth engineering; `mid` is small but not invisible and still
  // deserves a label, because leaving the category model unlabelled makes it
  // look free.
  var DOC = [
    { k: "ocr",        label: "Read the page",        s: 6.000, heavy: true },
    { k: "language",   label: "Detect language",      s: 0.006 },
    { k: "pii",        label: "Find personal detail", s: 0.021 },
    { k: "redact",     label: "Redact",               s: 0.053 },
    { k: "triage",     label: "Flag for review",      s: 0.001 },
    { k: "categorize", label: "Suggest category",     s: 0.749, mid: true },
    { k: "route",      label: "Suggest route",        s: 0.001 },
    { k: "summarize",  label: "Draft summary",        s: 6.590, heavy: true }
  ];
  // Typed path: there is no page to read, and the fixture did not exercise
  // summarisation. Neither absence is a claim that typed complaints are never
  // summarised -- it is what this benchmark run measured, and the note says so.
  var TXT = [
    { k: "language",   label: "Detect language",      s: 0.004 },
    { k: "pii",        label: "Find personal detail", s: 0.009 },
    { k: "redact",     label: "Redact",               s: 0.010, mid: true },
    { k: "triage",     label: "Flag for review",      s: 0.001 },
    { k: "categorize", label: "Suggest category",     s: 0.113, heavy: true },
    { k: "route",      label: "Suggest route",        s: 0.001 }
  ];
  var NOTE = {
    doc: "Replay at measured speed &middot; scanned path, e2e p50 <b>13.66s</b>, n=20. " +
         "Reading the page and drafting the summary are 92% of it.",
    txt: "Replay at measured speed &middot; typed path, e2e p50 <b>0.13s</b>, n=40 &mdash; " +
         "about <b>100&times;</b> faster. No page to read, and the fixture ran no summary; " +
         "the whole remaining cost is the category model."
  };
  var IN_H = { doc: "Scan &middot; 2 pages", txt: "Typed into the portal" };

  var root = document.getElementById("replay");
  if (!root) return;
  var track = document.getElementById("replay-track");
  var clock = document.getElementById("replay-clock");
  var go = document.getElementById("replay-go");
  var speed = document.getElementById("replay-speed");
  var note = document.getElementById("replay-note");
  var inbox = document.getElementById("replay-in");
  var inh = document.getElementById("replay-in-h");
  var path = "doc", stages = DOC, total = 0, timer = null;

  function build() {
    stages = path === "doc" ? DOC : TXT;
    total = stages.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.s; }, 0);

    // The two paths share a time axis, so the typed bar is visibly a sliver of
    // the scanned one -- that contrast IS the point of the toggle. A literal 1%
    // would be unreadable, so it floors at 13%, and the note carries the true
    // ratio in words. Setting this explicitly rather than letting flex-grow
    // values summing below 1 do it by accident, which is what happened first
    // and would break the moment someone edited a stage time.
    var DOC_TOTAL = DOC.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.s; }, 0);
    var frac = Math.max(total / DOC_TOTAL, 0.13);
    track.style.width = (100 * frac).toFixed(1) + "%";
    // Too narrow to letter. A clipped "S…" reads as a rendering fault rather
    // than as "this stage is too small to label", so drop the text and let the
    // note carry it.
    track.classList.toggle("replay-track-narrow", frac < 0.4);
    track.innerHTML = "";
    stages.forEach(function (st) {
      var seg = document.createElement("div");
      seg.className = "replay-seg" + (st.heavy ? " replay-seg-heavy" : st.mid ? " replay-seg-mid" : "");
      seg.style.flexGrow = String(st.s);
      seg.dataset.k = st.k;
      seg.innerHTML = '<span class="replay-fill"></span>' +
                      '<span class="replay-lab">' + st.label + "</span>" +
                      '<span class="replay-dur">' +
                      (st.s >= 0.05 ? st.s.toFixed(st.s < 1 ? 2 : 1) + "s" : "&lt;0.05s") + "</span>";
      track.appendChild(seg);
    });
    inbox.className = "replay-in replay-in-" + path;
    inh.innerHTML = IN_H[path];
    note.innerHTML = NOTE[path] +
      " Stage durations are recorded p50s; the outputs are canned and the petition is synthetic. No model is running.";
    reset();
  }

  function reset() {
    if (timer) { cancelAnimationFrame(timer); timer = null; }
    root.querySelectorAll(".replay-seg").forEach(function (e) { e.classList.remove("on", "done"); });
    root.querySelectorAll(".replay-card").forEach(function (e) { e.classList.remove("on"); });
    root.querySelectorAll(".replay-fill").forEach(function (e) { e.style.width = "0%"; });
    root.classList.remove("running");
    clock.textContent = "0.0s";
  }

  function run() {
    reset();
    root.classList.add("running");
    var mult = parseFloat(speed.dataset.mult);
    var t0 = performance.now();
    function frame(now) {
      var elapsed = ((now - t0) / 1000) * mult;
      clock.textContent = Math.min(elapsed, total).toFixed(2) + "s";
      var acc = 0;
      stages.forEach(function (st) {
        var seg = track.querySelector('[data-k="' + st.k + '"]');
        if (!seg) return;
        var fill = seg.querySelector(".replay-fill");
        var into = elapsed - acc;
        if (into <= 0) { fill.style.width = "0%"; }
        else if (into >= st.s) {
          fill.style.width = "100%";
          seg.classList.add("done"); seg.classList.remove("on");
          var card = root.querySelector('[data-out="' + st.k + '"]');
          if (card) card.classList.add("on");
        } else {
          fill.style.width = (100 * into / st.s).toFixed(1) + "%";
          seg.classList.add("on");
        }
        acc += st.s;
      });
      if (elapsed < total) { timer = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
      else {
        clock.textContent = total.toFixed(2) + "s";
        // Cards whose stage does not exist on this path stay dark, so the
        // typed run visibly produces no summary rather than silently implying
        // one appeared.
        timer = null;
      }
    }
    timer = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  go.addEventListener("click", run);
  speed.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var seq = { "1": "4", "4": "0.1", "0.1": "1" };
    var next = seq[speed.dataset.mult] || "1";
    speed.dataset.mult = next;
    speed.innerHTML = (next === "0.1" ? "slow" : next + "&times;");
  });
  document.getElementById("replay-path").addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
    var b = ev.target.closest("button");
    if (!b) return;
    path = b.dataset.path;
    this.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("active"); });
    b.classList.add("active");
    build();
  });

  if (window.Reveal && Reveal.on) {
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", function (e) {
      if (e.currentSlide && e.currentSlide.contains(root)) reset();
    });
  }

  build();
  root.classList.add("live");
})();
</script>
```
